name: Merrick
source:
A mercenary warrior who happened upon Mizari and Nerui while travelling for work.

Witnessing their skills, he could not pass up the opportunity to recruit them.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/mizari-loves-company]itch.io[/url]]
